definitions.explanation: The act of coughing, or the sound produced by coughing. A common symptom of colds and respiratory illness.

examples.japanese: {咳|せき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなくて→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
examples.english: My cough won't stop and it's miserable.
When coughing on the train, wear a mask or cover your mouth with your hand.

notes:
{咳|せき} refers to the act or sound of coughing. A common symptom discussed when talking about colds and illness.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {咳|せき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to have a cough (literally "a cough comes out" — the standard way to say it)
- {咳|せき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cough (deliberate action)
- {咳|せき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: can't stop coughing

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{咳|せき}{止|ど}め→咳止め：27038_sekidome⟧: cough medicine/suppressant
- {空咳|からぜき}: dry cough (no phlegm)
- {咳|せき}エチケット: cough etiquette (covering mouth, wearing mask)
- ⟦{咳払|せきばら}い→咳払い：06512_sekibarai⟧: clearing one's throat (often to get attention)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, wearing a mask when coughing in public is strongly expected as a matter of etiquette ({咳|せき}エチケット). Not doing so can draw disapproval.

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (seat/place) — same reading, different kanji.
